title: repo-room.ts header still names the deleted run-state-store/tracker-client as the run's publish path
body: repo-room.ts's header comment (line ~44) says the run's publishes — checkpoint, attempt markers, decisions, .tick/ records — go through 'run-state-store, tracker-client through the DO-backed contentsStore'. Both modules are deleted now; the room's publish path is still real (git-contents survives), but the comment names writers that no longer exist. Not fixed here because the acceptance criteria say the rooms are untouched.
